title: Sunke faq kubra ka
body:
sunke faq kubra ka chehra hogaya
tukde tukde ran may dulha hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi zainab ke ye kya hogaya
bhai bin ghar soon soona hogaya
sunke faq kubra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
poochte thay sar kata kar ye hussain
mere maalik mera sajda hogaya
sunke faq kubra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani akbar ko na asghar ko mila
pani darya ka kaleja hogaya
sunke faq kubra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis jagah qaime se uth'ta hai dhuan
khaana e kaaba may larza hogaya
sunke faq kubra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya sar e zainab se chadar chin gayi
dono aalam may andhera hogaya
sunke faq kubra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar chalo ghar meri amma ghar chalo
kehna kya bachi ka poora hogaya
sunke faq kubra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
bekhayali may ye laila ne kaha
do azan akbar savera hogaya
sunke faq kubra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
laash hai ya chaudvin ka chand hai
jaun kya tha aur ab kya hogaya
sunke faq kubra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bhi kya nauha na roye sayyeda
gir gaye aansu to nauha hogaya
sunke faq kubra ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas karo anwar ke aansu hai rawan
dekho tar rumaal e zehra hogaya
sunke faq kubra ka...
author: Anwar Zahir
